style.prompt: Create a polished ecommerce product photograph of the exact perfume bottle in the reference. Preserve its precise feminine torso silhouette, peach-pink translucent glass, liquid color, silver atomizer and loop top, neck detailing and small hanging charm; do not invent branding, lettering, caps or accessories. One bottle only, upright, front facing, entirely visible, centered in a square composition with generous clean margins. Seamless very light warm off-white studio background and surface, soft diffused premium studio lighting, controlled realistic highlights on glass and chrome, subtle natural contact shadow beneath the base. Crisp product detail, elegant restrained luxury ecommerce photography. No props, no extra text, no watermark. Keep the product design unchanged.
